name: tokentaby
description: Per-repo, per-developer Claude Code usage tracking — tokens, models, agents, tasks, prompts and estimated (API-equivalent) cost — committed to git, with a local team dashboard.

dev_id.title: Developer id
dev_id.description: Your id in .tokentaby/devs/<id>/. Leave empty to use the local part of your git user.email.

prompt_mode.title: Prompt logging
prompt_mode.description: How much prompt text to log: team (use the repo's policy), truncated (first 200 chars), hash_only (no text), full. The repo's policy is a floor: you can be more private, never less.

sync.title: Git sync mode
sync.description: team (use the repo's setting), ride-along (usage ships inside your normal commits), auto-commit (a usage-only commit at session end, never pushed), manual (/tt sync).

port.title: Dashboard port
port.description: Local port for the dashboard (tokentaby serve / /tt serve).

currency.title: Display currency
currency.description: Currency for estimated costs in the dashboard and /tt — the ones Claude bills in: USD, INR or EUR. Rates come from the fx table in .tokentaby/pricing.json.
